definitions.explanation: Describes something magnificently beautiful with rich, vivid colors and elaborate ornamentation. Often used in formal or literary contexts for exceptional splendor.

examples.japanese: {絢爛|けんらん}⟦{豪華|ごうか}→豪華：02815_gouka⟧
{絢爛|けんらん}たる⟦{衣装|いしょう}→衣装：14102_ishou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧まとった。
{桃山|ももやま}⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{絢爛|けんらん}たる⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝|つた}える→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧⟦{城|しろ}→城：03255_shiro⟧だ。
examples.english: This castle conveys the brilliant culture of the Momoyama period.

notes:
ADJECTIVE TYPE: Na-adjective. Often used as {絢爛|けんらん}たる (literary attributive form) or {絢爛|けんらん}な.

FOUR-CHARACTER COMPOUND: {絢爛|けんらん}⟦{豪華|ごうか}→豪華：02815_gouka⟧ (gorgeously splendid) is a common set phrase emphasizing extravagant beauty.

NUANCE: {絢爛|けんらん} is more literary and elevated than ⟦{華麗|かれい}→華麗：09199_karei⟧. It suggests rich, elaborate beauty with vivid colors, often used for art, architecture, or cultural artifacts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {絢爛|けんらん}⟦{豪華|ごうか}→豪華：02815_gouka⟧ (gorgeous and splendid)
- {絢爛|けんらん}たる⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧ (brilliant culture)
- {絢爛|けんらん}たる⟦{色彩|しきさい}→色彩：13956_shikisai⟧ (dazzling colors)
- {絢爛|けんらん}な⟦{装飾|そうしょく}→装飾：14104_soushoku⟧ (gorgeous ornamentation)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{華麗|かれい}→華麗：09199_karei⟧ (splendid, gorgeous - more common)
- ⟦{豪華|ごうか}→豪華：02815_gouka⟧ (luxurious, gorgeous)
- {燦爛|さんらん} (brilliant, radiant)
- ⟦{質素|しっそ}→質素：09201_shisso⟧ (simple, plain - opposite)
